coder_notes: Toca 511 (vocimagene amiretrorepvec) is a retroviral gene therapy -> excluded_intervention_type. Extended-release flucytosine (Toca FC) coded as the only pharmacological investigational agent (experimental_monotherapy, new_formulation) but flagged uncertain because it is the prodrug half of a gene-directed enzyme prodrug system; if adjudicated as part of the excluded gene therapy, S6 reason would be excluded_intervention_type. Conditions list anaplastic astrocytoma and oligodendroglioma, but entry requires presumptive glioblastoma; non-GBM final pathology patients are treated but excluded from the primary analysis, so coded gbm_only (alternative: mixed_glioma_gbm_named). Optune (TTFields device) optional in control arm only; not an agent. IDH and MGMT are analysed as correlates; stratification factors are not named in the record. EGFR amplification is mentioned only as an example of what methylation profiling can reveal, not recorded separately. Dexamethasone/corticosteroid use is monitored, not a registered intervention.
